title: Vermont Oxford Network Very Low Birth Weight Database
official: Vermont Oxford Network Very Low Birth Weight Database of Infants <=1500 Grams or <=29 Weeks Gestational Age at Birth
summary: Vermont Oxford Network maintains a database for live born infants \<=1500 grams or \<=29 weeks gestational age who are born at participating hospitals or admitted to them within 28 days of birth, regardless of where in the hospital the infant receives care.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any infant who is born alive and whose birth weight is \<=1500 grams or \<=29 weeks 6 days gestational age (inclusive) who is born at or admitted to a Vermont Oxford Network member center within 28 days of life without having first gone home, regardless of the where the infant receives care

Exclusion Criteria:

* Stillborn infants
* Infants discharged home prior to admission to a member center
* Infants admitted after 28 days
